lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Is everyone ready?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah woo!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: If everyone's ready, Gretel and I say we get going. Now.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Then, everyone, hop on the bubble.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: *Sigh* Guess we're in for another few days crossing that endless ocean.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hehe... I suppose it can't be helped.
Just then, Mori stops.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Mori?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Siren, Grave, Cinderella, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'm not going.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Oh...! What?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: You're not coming?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Mori?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'm going to stay here

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: and help Bernoullia.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: That's what I suggested to Hansel and Gretel.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I told them I'd stay behind, so they should go on with everyone else without worrying about us.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... Yes, that's why we decided to run away from home.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I trust Mori to keep Ber safe.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Hm... Thanks, Hansel, Gretel.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Why... would you want to stay...?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I think someone should stay behind and help Bernoullia.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: That way, Hansel and Gretel can move forward without having to worry.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: To be honest... I'm not confident I can hold my own on the battlefield,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: and I don't want to become a burden to the people I care about.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: No, Mori! You're not—

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Siren.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: While I was here, I spent a long time

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: thinking about who I am, about what I can do right now,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: *sigh...* and whether I can become stronger.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Mori...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I want to do my best for the people I care about, too.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Of course... It hurts that I can't go with you. I'm sad, and I feel guilty about it...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I even thought maybe I'd rather die fighting alongside you on the battlefield...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: But I can't do that.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I can't fight with that kind of mindset.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You're going up against an enemy that you'll only be able to beat if you give it everything you've got,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: so I want to do my best to help everyone win, too.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I just want all of you to come back without getting hurt.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I want to be someone who can be there for the people I care about.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: That's why I'm going to do what I can do best right now.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Which is staying here?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'll stay here and protect Bernoullia

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: and the home everyone will come back to...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: So Hansel and Gretel can fight without having to worry.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: That's the conclusion I've come to.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: So! Don't get hurt, okay?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Come back safe after you win.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'll be rooting for you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Oh...
Little Mermaid gazes into Mori's eyes.
Those same eyes Mori had when she dove back into Gluttony's throat and reached out her hand to Little Mermaid.
The same unwavering resolve in her eyes when she put her life on the line to save her.
Once again, those eyes are looking back at her.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah... Looks like you've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You're a strong person. You always have been.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I-I am?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We promise we'll win and come back, Mori.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You stay safe too and wait for us to come back.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Ah... Okay!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Let's... go, then.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: We'll see you when we return, Mori.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: See you soon.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Please take good care of Ber.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: We're counting on you.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'll do my best.
They all get onto the bubble.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We'll be back, Mori.
The bubble begins to drift toward the distant sea.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Take care, everyone!
Mori waves goodbye to the bubble as it carries everyone away.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: *Sigh...* You have to come back.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Oh right,

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: there's something Gretel and I forgot to tell you.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We left the Witches Cauldron back home.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Oh...! Wh-what do we do? Should I turn the bubble around?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: No, we might get caught by Ber.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: If we saw her face, Gretel and I might feel too guilty to leave.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: So we should probably get help from that prince Cinderella mentioned...?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Ask Superhuman for help...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: If that doesn't work out... um... maybe Siren could make it with her bubbles?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah, ah woo...!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I-I'll do my best to make it!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Calm down, everyone.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Before we do anything, take a look at this.
Cinderella points to a box off to one side.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It's from Bernoullia.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: From Ber?

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Let's open it.
Hansel and Gretel opens the box.
Last night, in Bernoullia's lab, before hearing Hansel and Gretel's plan to run away...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You told Hansel and Gretel that if they wanted to fight with us,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: they had to be prepared to leave you here alone, with only one leg?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Indeed.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why would you put it like that?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: They'll get the wrong idea.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: I'm afraid I don't know what misunderstanding you're referring to.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why be so harsh with them?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You could've simply told them you didn't want them going to war because you were worried about them.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Do you really think those two would listen just because I told them so?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: And if they need my gracious permission before they'll go,

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: then they have no business going at all.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: To march onto a battlefield without even that much resolve... they'd be practically walking to their deaths, wouldn't they?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Oh... You must be quite worried.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Enough of that. Take this.
*Thud*
Bernoullia sets a box down in front of Cinderella.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Uh... What's this?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Go on, open it.
Cinderella opens the box.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: *Gasp!*

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: This...!
Inside the box lies Hansel and Gretel's weapon, the Witches Cauldron.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Take it, and spare me the arguments. It'll prove useful.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: So you knew they were going to leave.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Of course, who do you think raised them?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Those hellions are an open book.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: They'll be talking about running away from home and declaring that you ought to leave at first light.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: So take it.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Don't let those careless hellions leave it behind.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hehe... You're quite an odd one.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Heh, look at you, already treating me like a proper person after only a few days together.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I know you don't consider yourself a Rapture.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Whether my body is that of a Heretic, a Rapture, or a Nikke...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I am still me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: And you are still you, are you not?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Hehe, indeed.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Who could presume to define me

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: when I alone decide who I am?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Bernoullia,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: you taught me how to protect myself

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: for Hansel and Gretel's sake, didn't you?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Whatever could have given you that idea?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You wanted to give me the power to protect them,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: so they wouldn't get hurt in battle.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Ahh...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Thank you for saving my family and taking such good care of them all these years.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: You do say the most ridiculous things.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: They are not your family.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: They are my hellions.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Whatever they may have been in the past, they are my precious possessions now.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: So there's no need for you to thank me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Yes, I'm glad Hansel and Gretel are so dear to you, too.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Hmph!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'm finally getting used to the way you speak. It's a shame we won't have more time to talk.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Enough nonsense.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: When you return, you'd best be prepared to tell me how the corruption works.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Are we... allowed to come back here?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Were you planning to take what you needed and simply run off, then?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Put such foolish notions out of your head, and concern yourself with bringing my little hellions back to me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Mm... Yes, we'll be back, I promise.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: So Ber... knew everything.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She knew exactly what we were thinking, and yet she still let us go.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Yes.
A firefly emerges from the Witches Cauldron and flutters toward Hansel and Gretel.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: This is...!

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Ber's nanomachine...!

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: You belong to me, so don't go getting yourselves hurt.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Come back in one piece, you runaway hellions.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Ngh...

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Hic...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Hngh... *Sniff* Ber...!

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: *Sniff*

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Agh... If you're going to cry, stop it at once. You'll look ugly.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Hehe!

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: ... Pfft.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Haha... Hahahaha!
The firefly flies back toward the house they left behind.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Take care, Ber!

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: We'll be back.
Hansel and Gretel wave to the firefly
until they can no longer see the sweet witch's house
that sheltered them when they were lost and wandering after losing their home.
GINGERBREAD HOUSE: THE END
